introduction.text: This website is dedicated to one of my most favourite video game franchises of all time - Yakuza (originally called "Ryu Ga Gotoku" [Like a Dragon] in Japan). It is without a doubt a one of a kind collection of unique aesthetic and quite original storyline, including the gameplay style. It consists of 23 entries, including base products and remakes. Since the first release, which happened in the year 2005, we follow the story of a man - Kiryu Kazuma. He is the main protagonist of the whole series, who occurs in most of the games as the character we follow. The main timeline spans over 40 years. With that being said, the franchise points out the social and common problems in Japan due to the specific time period or cultural differations. The series became internationally successful after almost 10 years, with the release of Yakuza 0. It was a crucial point for the series, which allowed to "open" the series to the west, where previously some of the games have not even received an international release, with some of the reasons being the cultural difference and possible "cultural misunderstanding". The franchise itself became a huge "meme" itself, due to the humorous and absurd nature of some situations, including the cutscenes. Features a "beat-em-up" style of gameplay with a "sparkle" of RPG. However, since the release of the game Yakuza: Like a Dragon, the mainline gameplay style has changed to J-RPG, similiar to other franchises like Persona.

image.description: Haruka Sawamura in her idol suit from Yakuza 5

soundtrack.text: However, one of the most important elements of the series is the soundtrack itself. The production is heavily praised for the original approach and unique connection, creating a one of a kind atmopshere. With the help of legendary SEGA composer Hidenori Shoji and other notable composers, such as Mitsuharu Fukuyama, who created probably the biggest song in the franchise - Baka Mitai (eng. I was a fool). That concludes the fact, that the whole soundtrack in the franchise is original, apart from a few exceptions, where actual licensed songs were included in the game. Although most of these were only in the japanese versions of the release, it still should be a notable mention. Production ranges from genres like rock or metal, jazz, groove, ballads, enka, j-pop to even synthwave, disco and dubstep.

symbols.text: Through the series, we follow the stories of multiple protagonists. Even though every single person is unique, their problems are universal. Some of the stories hold universal truths or morals. Most notably, the series points out how self-destructive a human ego can be. At the same time, we can witness the strength of friendship, which can sound childish, yet realistically true.

image.description: Daigo Dojima in his fisherman suit from Like a Dragon: Infinite Wealth

morals.text: Some of the morals include traditional values, like family, which is probably the most important symbol. With the main protagonist being an orphan, including his future adoptive daughter, we realize what it means to be a family and what it takes to create one. This is also factual due to the fact Kiryu had his own orphanage in Okinawa. Although, with organisations like the Tojo Clan we also come to a realization how important respect is in our daily life.

character.name: Kiryu
character.description: Kazuma appeared in every mainline franchise game. Raised by Shintaro Kazama (of the Dojima Family), since Kiryu was an orphan himself.

tattoo.title: Oryu/Yinglong
tattoo.explanation: A symbol of power, wisdom, protection and balance in Japanese culture.

character.name: Haruka
character.description: A lost soul who tries to find her place on earth. Due to complicated life along a former yakuza, Haruka matured as a child.

character.name: Goro
character.description: Majima is one of the original characters, which occured in every single mainline game since the release of the first volume.

tattoo.title: Hannya
tattoo.explanation: The Hannya mask is commonly believed to depict women who have turned into demons as a result of being consumed by rage, envy or sorrow. Snakes are often a symbol of rebirth and transformation due to their tendency to shed their skin.

character.name: Kaoru

role.organisation: Osaka Prefectural Police's Sotenbori District Organized Crime Division

character.description: Studied programming and cybersecurity, hence joining the tech crimes unit at the age of 20. Sayama has a very deep and complicated background. Throughout the most important task of her career, she came to known her actual descendancy and family story. (Un)knowingly connected to Ryuji Goda. Love interest of Kiryu Kazuma

character.name: Ryuji
character.description: Also known as the "Dragon of Kansai", which sparked some controversy in contrary with Kazuma's "Dragon of Dojima". Ryuji believed only one dragons belongs in Japan. Second patriarch of the Go-Ryu Clan, an Omi Alliance subsidiary. Famous for his strength and height, as well as his blonde hair and huge scar on his face. (Un)familiar with his actual descendancy and family story. His tattoo is the legendary gold dragon, Huang Long, who lords over the four gods of the cardinal directions, representing Ryuji's ambitions to rule over all of Japan's criminal underworld.

tattoo.title: Huang Long
tattoo.explanation: His tattoo is the legendary gold dragon, Huang Long, who lords over the four gods of the cardinal directions, representing Ryuji's ambitions to rule over all of Japan's criminal underworld.

character.name: Rikiya
character.description: A very strong character with an original appearence. Has a punch perm hairstyle. Extremely loyal and connected to the place of his birth, hence why he has never been to the motherland. Met Kiryu in 2009 and became great friends ever since. His tattoo depicts a viper - specifically an Okinawan habu - pit viper native to the region.

tattoo.title: Okinawan Habu
tattoo.explanation: Pit viper native to the region.

character.name: Yoshitaka
character.description: Main antagonist of Yakuza 3. An important element of the Tojo Clan's income between 2007 and 2009, gaining him the nickname of the "Safekeeper of the Tojo Clan". A close person to Daigo Dojima.

tattoo.title: Kirin
tattoo.explanation: A mythical creature said to appear only in the presence of a leader and become protective if a pure person is threatened by a malicious one.

character.opinion: One of the best written characters

character.name: Shun
character.description: Working alongside his secretary Hana. He was a top employee in the Touto Bank, but got sacked due to the charges of embezzlement. Unfairly accused, he soon became homeless. However, due to the bomb explosion in the Millennium Tower, followed by the ¥10 billion raining down from the sky, Akiyama managed to gather some of the money to try his luck for the second time, with success.

character.name: Masayoshi

role.organisation: Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department's Community Safety Division

character.description: Fairly called "The Parasite Of Kamurocho" due to his poor attitude towards work and open engagement in acts of corruption. However, he is always willingly open to help those in need. Due to his upbringing of mixed descendancy, the man was helping the immigrant children who were left without parents. Masayoshi was even gambling and blackmailing illegal/criminal businesses to help the children in need.

character.name: Taiga
character.description: Due to his (in)famous slaying of the eighteen members of the Ueno Seiwa Clan and surviving to receive the death penalty, Saejima earned the nickname "18-Counts Saejima". A great friend of Goro Majima.

tattoo.title: Tiger
tattoo.explanation: His tattoo features a roaring tiger surrounded by bamboo grass. In Buddhism, it is believed that tiger and dragon are equal to each other, hence why Kiryu and Saejima are one of the most powerful yakuza members, yet having opposite traits.

character.name: Tatsuo
character.description: Shinada was unfairly arrested on suspicion of game fixing and illegal gambling. While he was eventually cleared of all the charges, he was banned for life from professional baseball. He attended Kamuro West High School alongside Daigo Dojima. A man with a complicated story, living in poor conditions. However, he seems to enjoy his life.
character.opinion: Appeared in one game, yet impactful

character.name: Daigo
character.description: Once a drunk street thug, Daigo becomes the sixth (and the last) chairman of the Tojo Clan by the recommendation of Kazuma Kiryu. The son of Sohei Dojima represents a new generation of the yakuza. A charismatic and caring character, born to be a leader.

tattoo.title: Fudo Myoo
tattoo.explanation: Defender of the Buddhist faith. Represents knowledge and power, thanks to the Kurikara sword. The fire represents the cleansing, while the dragon that surrounds the sword could be a sign of Kiryu's guidance for Daigo over the years.

character.name: Ichiban
character.description: Ichiban became the main protagonist since Yakuza: Like a Dragon. A key member of the Great Dissolution of the Tojo Clan and the Omi Alliance.

tattoo.title: Dragonfish
tattoo.explanation: The in-between state of a koi fish transforming into a dragon. The legend of Koi states that the koi fish that swims up to the top of the waterfall is rewarded for its resilience by being transformed into a dragon. It is supposed to be a symbol of power, resilience and strength in the times of struggle and trouble.

character.name: Takayuki
character.description: Main protagonist of the spin-off series Judgment. Works as a private investigator alongside Masaharu Kaito. Yagami became a lawyer due to the fact that his own father was one. However, he felt the urge to follow his father under the circumstances of his elders decisions. His father was defending a man accused of strangling an underage girl, who he has proven not guilty. The consequences were real, as the victim's father murdered Yagami's parents and himself. This motivated Yagami to become a lawyer himself and "fix" the unfair reputation. The orphan had a successful career, which led to a similiar situation as in the past. Due to the murder done by his client, Yagami stepped down due to the feeling of guilt. He has started his own private investigative agency, Yagami Detective Agency.

character.name: Masaharu
character.description: A fellow friend and co-worker of Takayuki Yagami. Due to a robbery in the family's office, he was almost forced to perform Yubitsume, which was disallowed by Yagami and Matsugane himself. Instead, he was expelled from the family. Shortly after, he has joined the Yagami Detective Agency, becomming a private investigator himself.

character.name: Tatsuya
character.description: Major character in the spin-off series Kurohyou. Formerly a rowdly youth, gets involved with the Tojo Clan as a top fighter in their underground coliseum, earning him the nickname "The Mad Dragon of Kamuro".

character.name: Makoto
character.description: Protagonist of STRANGER THAN HEAVEN. Born to an american father and japanese mother.

game.title: Yakuza
game.description: The debut release of SEGA's Toshihiro Nagoshi. Based in a 1995/2005 Tokyo's fictional entertainment district Kamurocho, we follow the story of young Kiryu Kazuma, who seeks for answers to many mysteries and tragedies. After serving ten years in prison, the man needs to find himself in a changed world of yakuza.
game.opinion: Major debut of an aspiring franchise

game.title: Yakuza 2
game.description: A year after the emotional events of the previous installment, The Dragon of Dojima has to face new challenges, as the great danger arises from Osaka's Omi Alliance. With the help of Daigo Dojima and a later addition of Kaoru Sayama, they face new threats and enemies, such as the Jingweon Mafia. Includes a lot of twists and shocking discoveries.
game.opinion: Perfectly written

game.title: Ryu Ga Gotoku: Kenzan!
game.description: First ever spin-off release from the Yakuza franchise. The game is set in historical Kyoto, Japan during the Edo period in 1605. The story follows the parts of Miyamoto Musashi's life. It is one of the two games based on historical figures and heritage of Japan. Kenzan has never been released outside of Japan, which makes it's status even more "iconic".

game.title: Yakuza 3
game.description: Following the events of 2006, Kazuma comes to a conclusion to leave Kamurocho with his adoptive daugher, Haruka. They leave Tokyo for Okinawa, where they open up an orphanage, Morning Glory. Thrown into a dirty business, the former yakuza must help his friend - Daigo Dojima - to stop Yoshitaka Mine from tragic consequences of his actions.
game.opinion: Unique atmosphere

game.title: Yakuza 4
game.description: A soft reset in the timeline happens with the introduction of three new protagonists: Shun Akiyama, Masayoshi Tanimura and Taiga Saejima. Four unique personalities with a lot in common bound together to fight with corrupt and disheartening opponents. Can a washed-up yakuza, money launderer, local detective and prison escapee save Kamurocho?
game.opinion: Revolutionary idea of having four protagonists

game.title: Kurohyou: Ryu Ga Gotoku Shinsho

image.description: Logo of Kurohyou: Ryu Ga Gotoku Shinsho (2010)

game.description: An exclusive release for Sony PlayStation Portable. Just like the previous spin-off, Black Panther was never released outside of Japan. Produced by "Def Jam: Fight For NY"'s AKI Corporation, the game received a similiar gameplay style, focused more on one-on-one brawling, unlike the other Yakuza releases. The game features an original (in contrary with other franchise's releases) set of animated cutscenes.

game.title: Yakuza: Dead Souls
game.description: A Sony Play Station 3 exclusive release, who saw a global debut. Dead Souls takes place in a non-canon timeline after the events of Yakuza 4. It features a different style of gameplay - a third-person shooter. Four playable characters: Kiryu Kazuma, Ryuji Goda, Shun Akiyama and Goro Majima. The release follows the story of a zombie apocalypse that revolves around the protagonists trying to keep them and their loved ones safe while putting an end to this great danger.
game.opinion: A fun and absurd story focused on an apocalypse-ruined Kamurocho

game.title: Kurohyo 2: Ryu Ga Gotoku Ashura-hen

image.description: Logo of Kurohyo 2: Ryu Ga Gotoku Ashura-hen (2012)

game.description: Sequel of the first Kurohyou game. Just like the previous installment, it is a PSP and Japan exclusive game. Includes the same exact unique features of the previous release.

game.title: Yakuza 5
game.description: With the addition of Tatsuo Shinada, we receive a much deeper and complex story of five protagonsits: Tatsuo Shinada, Kiryu Kazuma, Shun Akiyama, Taiga Saejima and Haruka Sawamura. Possibly one of the most well-written entries on the list. A retired baseballer, former yakuza, money launderer, prisoner and an idol - will everyone overcome their biggest struggles and achieve their dream?
game.opinion: Now with five protagonists!

game.title: Ryu Ga Gotoku Ishin!

image.description: Logo of Ryu Ga Gotoku Ishin! (2014)

game.description: A second release based on historical figures and stories. Japan exclusive, later released globally with the remake titled Like a Dragon: Ishin!. Ishin focuses on the Bakumatsu Period in Japan. The story focuses on the story of Sakamoto Ryoma, who seeks justice for the death of his mentor - Yoshida Toyo.

game.title: Yakuza 0
game.platforms: PS3 PS4 PS5 X360 XONE PC
game.description: The series' prequel set in 1988 Kamurocho and Sotenbori, following the story of two protagonists: Kiryu Kazuma and Goro Majima. After being framed with murder, Kiryu leaves the Dojima Family in search of the answer for the complicated story of the Empty Lot. The one-eyed assassin however tries to repair the damage he has done in the past. He receives a chance to fix his mistakes, but everything changes once he meets the victim.
game.opinion: A flashback to the origins of Kiryu Kazuma and Majima Goro

game.title: Yakuza Kiwami
game.platforms: PS3 PS4 PS5 X360 XONE PC
game.description: A remake of the 2005 release of Yakuza, featuring a whole new game engine and refreshed arrangement. With the addition of a huge amount of mechanics, the game receives a whole new life to itself.
game.opinion: Faithful remake of the original debut game with great additions

game.title: Yakuza 6
game.description: A personal story of Kiryu Kazuma, who seeks justice for his adoptive daughter - Haruka Sawamura - who was a victim of a dramatic car accident. With shocking discoveries, the Dragon of Dojima has to face unexpected challenges and twists, including the discovery of a government secret, which consequences would be irreverseble.
game.opinion: A very deep and emotional story line

game.title: Yakuza Kiwami 2
game.description: After the success of the previous remake, the decision has been made to release a refreshed version of the 2006 Yakuza 2. However, this time RGG has decided to "play it safe" with minor and soft changes in contrary with the first Kiwami. Built on the recently introduced Dragon Engine.
game.opinion: A safe play with poor adaptations, unsatisfying remake

game.title: Judgment
game.description: A debut release of the successful spin-off series. Focusing on the life of a private detective, Takayuki Yagami, who tries to solve the mystery of the "the Mole" - a murderer and threat to Kamurocho. On his way to truth, Yagami finds shocking and disstressing discoveries.
game.opinion: Huge debut of a greatly written "side" project

game.title: Yakuza: Like a Dragon

image.description: Logo of Yakuza: Like a Dragon (2020)

game.description: A soft reboot of the series, with a new protagonist Ichiban Kasuga and a new gameplay style based on the J-RPG (turn-based roleplay) genre. The story follows a young man - Ichiban Kasuga - born and raised in a soapland in Kamurocho. After his life was saved by Masumi Arakawa, a patriarch of the Arakawa Family, young man decides to dedicate his life to serve his "hero". After being asked to to take the fall for Jo Sawashiro - family's captain - Kasuga comes to a conclusion to repay his debt. After serving eighteen years in prison, he faces confusing changes in the world - including the Omi Alliance control of Tokyos' Kamurocho. With new friends on his road, Ichiban has to find the reason of all his troubles.
game.opinion: Soft (and successful) reboot of the franchise, introducing and focusing on a new protagonist

game.title: Lost Judgment
game.description: The sequel to the successful debut of Judgment. This time, Yagami, tries to uncover the dark story of Seiryo High School. With tragic and visual discoveries, detective has to face the brutality of the world.
game.opinion: One of the best projects from RGG Studios

game.title: The Kaito Files

image.description: Logo of Lost Judgment: The Kaito Files (2022)

game.description: A downloadable content to Lost Judgment. This time, we follow the story of Masaharu Kaito - co-worker of Yagami - who searches for Mikiko Sadamoto alongside his alleged son, Jun Sadamoto.
game.opinion: Great, yet short content addition for Lost Judgment

game.title: Like a Dragon: Ishin!

image.description: Logo of Like a Dragon: Ishin! (2023)

game.description: A remake of the 2014 Ryu Ga Gotoku Ishin!. The game has been boosted with a few major gameplay changes, including multiple fighting styles, virtue system and special attributes.
game.opinion: A remake of a 2014 version of the game with a few unnecessary mechanics

game.title: Like a Dragon Gaiden: The Man Who Erased His Name

image.description: Like a Dragon Gaiden: The Man Who Erased His Name (2020)

game.link: Like a Dragon Gaiden: The Man Who Erased His Name
game.description: An interquel between Yakuza: Like a Dragon and Like a Dragon: Infinite Wealth, focusing on the story of Joryu. The purpose of this release is to explain the further story and reasoning behind the "death" of Kiryu Kazuma. The game's finale connects with the finale of Yakuza: Like a Dragon. An emotional rollercoaster.
game.opinion: An emotional add-on to the story of Yakuza: Like a Dragon

game.title: Like a Dragon: Infinite Wealth

image.description: Logo of Like a Dragon: Infinite Wealth (2024)

game.description: A sequel of Yakuza: Like a Dragon with dual protagonists: Kiryu Kazuma and Ichiban Kasuga. With Ichiban seeking his mother, he travels to Honolulu, where he meets Kazuma. With similiar, yet different objectives, they connect their powers and help each other out. The grand finale consists of Kasuga fighting inequality and a great danger, while a terminally ill Kiryu stands face-to-face with his past. Probably the largest storyline in the series.
game.opinion: Connecting two protagonists and two generations into a one, major happening

game.title: Like a Dragon: Pirate Yakuza in Hawaii

image.description: Logo of Like a Dragon: Pirate Yakuza in Hawaii (2025)

game.link: Like a Dragon: Pirate Yakuza in Hawaii
game.description: A spin-off focusing on the confusing story of Goro Majima, who suffers from amnesia. The game is somewhat connected to the story of the previous major release - Like a Dragon: Infinite Wealth.
game.opinion: An enjoyable side game with a bare connection to the main plot

game.title: Yakuza Kiwami 3
game.description: A controversial remake of the 2009 Yakuza 3, which received a modern engine with it's revelations. The game received mixed-to-negative opinions due to a massive change in the storyline, including a few recasts. The game came out with an additional "mini-game", Dark Ties.
game.opinion: Unsatysfing and unneccessary changes in the plot

game.title: Dark Ties
game.description: A bonus game included with Yakuza Kiwami 3, focusing on the main game's antagonist - Yoshitaka Mine - which is the main protagonist of this product. The release explains the backstory of the main villain, specifically before the main game's timeline. The finale connects with the main game's finale.
game.opinion: A small, bonus game showing the backstory of Yakuza Kiwami 3 main antagonist, Yoshitaka Mine

game.title: STRANGER THAN HEAVEN
game.description: An upcoming major release, serving as a possible prequel to the whole Yakuza / Like a Dragon series. Currently, we know that the game will feature five cities: Kokura (1915), Kure (1929), Minami (1943), Atami (1951), Shinjuku (1965). We follow the story of a half-Japanese boy named Makoto Daito. With the story spanning over 60 years of action, it seems to be the longest-paced game from the studio.
game.opinion: Looks promising pre-release
